hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\||\s)sudo(\s|$)'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"sudo is not allowed"}'; exit 0; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"rm -rf is not allowed"}'; exit 0; fi; }
